mechanism: Ketorolac (NSAID) combined with tazarotene (retinoid) increases risk of skin irritation, photosensitivity, and potentially impaired wound healing due to additive dermatologic effects and NSAID-induced epithelial changes.
action: Monitor for excessive skin irritation, erythema, and photosensitivity; counsel patient on sun protection and consider alternative analgesic if topical tazarotene application site overlaps with NSAID use area.
